rationale: A shard needs its ordered, immutable set of logical trials to define what the controller executes. The member records carry task identity and stable digests, so this is not a redundant generic container.
alternatives: derive from the manifest, but that would make the plan insufficient to determine its own shard composition
merge into runs[].shards, but the trials are a real repeated child concept with per-trial identities
simplestChoice: Keep trials as the explicit collection of trial specifications owned by each shard.
